'''Destom Wuff''' was an individual sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] as part of a survey team to [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|investigate]] the wreckage of [[Darth Malgus]]'s [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" /> around [[3623 BBY]].<ref name="Death" /> Wuff was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the mission.<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" />

==Behind the scenes==
Destom Wuff first appeared in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
